text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса races toward the NHK
Mile Cup.
However, she also has a
problem on her hands.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She has no rivals running in the same
races as her
and longs for someone to
hone her abilities with.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She invites Кинг Хало to join her in the
NHK Mile
Cup out of desperation, but
her reckless request
is turned down.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Witnessing the exchange, I rack my
brain for a
way to make her wish for a
rival come true.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
